rules.rule: Electronics can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unopened and in original packaging.
conditions: Item must be within 7 days of delivery
All accessories and manuals must be included
exceptions: Customized or engraved items cannot be returned
Items damaged due to misuse are not eligible

rules.rule: Fashion items can be returned within 15 days of delivery. Items must be unworn with original tags attached.
conditions: Item must be within 15 days of delivery
Item must be unworn and unwashed
exceptions: Innerwear and swimwear are non-returnable for hygiene reasons
Customized fashion items cannot be returned

rules.rule: Groceries and perishable items are non-returnable except in case of damage or expired products at delivery.
conditions: Damage or expiry must be reported within 24 hours
exceptions: Sealed packaged groceries within shelf life cannot be returned

rules.rule: Home and kitchen items can be returned within 10 days if unused and in original packaging.
exceptions: Mattresses cannot be returned once unpacked
